title: Finite etale projection exchange and composition words
statement: For a commutative ring A and schemes, use ordinary etale derived pullback, direct image and tensor. Define the projection as the transpose of the counit. For P=P^1_S, W=P times_S P and its diagonal Delta, define diagonalPull through the canonical pullback compositor and identity, sourceUnit through the pasted adjunction units, diagonalProjection through projection and the scalar unitor, and exchange for both orders of the two projections through the Cartesian square mate. The coefficient towers, normalized section operations, and positive classes use [det-sp-tower-classes] and [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].
